'''Sportgemeinschaft Dynamo Dresden e.V.''', commonly known as '''SG Dynamo Dresden''' or '''Dynamo Dresden''', is a German [[association football]] club based in [[Dresden]], [[Saxony]].<ref name="vereinslexikon">Grüne, Hardy (2001). Enzyklopädie des deutschen Ligafußballs 7. Vereinslexikon. Kassel: Agon-Sportverlag. {{ISBN|978-3-89784-147-5}}.</ref> They were founded on 12 April 1953 as a club affiliated with the East German [[Volkspolizei|police]]<ref name="history-50s">{{cite web|url=http://www.dynamo-dresden.de/verein/tradition/geschichte/1948-1959/|title=Die Fünfziger: Gründerjahre|work=Dynamo Dresden|language=de|access-date=11 November 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101110183003/http://www.dynamo-dresden.de/verein/tradition/geschichte/1948-1959/|archive-date=10 November 2010|url-status=live}}</ref> and became one of the most popular and successful clubs in [[East German football league system|East German football]], winning eight [[East German football champions|league titles]].<ref name="honours">{{cite web|url=http://www.dynamo-dresden.de/verein/tradition/erfolge/|title=Erfolge|work=Dynamo Dresden|language=de|access-date=9 November 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101110034512/http://www.dynamo-dresden.de/verein/tradition/erfolge/|archive-date=10 November 2010|url-status=live}}</ref> The club is known for its dedicated fan culture of [[Ultras|Dynamo Ultras]], and elaborate [[Tifo|choreographs]].

After the [[German reunification|reunification of Germany]], Dynamo played four seasons in the top division, [[Bundesliga]], from 1991 to 1995,<ref name="honours" /><ref name="history-90s">{{cite web|url=http://www.dynamo-dresden.de/verein/tradition/geschichte/1990-1999/|title=Die Neunziger: Bundesliga und 3.Liga|work=Dynamo Dresden|language=de|access-date=9 November 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101109033655/http://www.dynamo-dresden.de/verein/tradition/geschichte/1990-1999|archive-date=9 November 2010|url-status=live}}</ref> but have since drifted between the second and fourth tiers.<ref name="seasons">{{cite web|url=http://www.dynamo-dresden.de/archiv/spielzeiten/|title=SAISON – ARCHIV|work=Dynamo Dresden|access-date=11 November 2010|language=de|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101023173515/http://www.dynamo-dresden.de/archiv/spielzeiten/|archive-date=23 October 2010|url-status=live}}</ref> The club competes in the [[2. Bundesliga]], the second division of German Football following promotion in the 2024–25 season.

The club's traditional kit colours are gold and black, derived from the official city flag and the [[coat of arms]] of the city of Dresden.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dresden Family Crest, Coat of Arms and Name Meaning |url=https://crestsandarms.com/pages/dresden-family-crest-coat-of-arms |access-date=2 September 2025 |website=Crests & Arms |language=en}}</ref>"}}
